kill_switch.title: Agent kill switch
kill_switch.intro: Suspends every agent registered for this deployment at once. One administrator can do it — it only takes power away — and it is recorded in the audit log and alerted. Pending holds on the agent registry are withdrawn. Reactivating an agent stays a held change that a second administrator approves (Trusted Agents).
kill_switch.intro_tenant: Suspends every agent registered for {tenant} at once. It only takes power away, so no second operator is needed; it is recorded in the tenant's audit log and alerted, and the pending holds on its agent registry are withdrawn. Reactivating an agent stays a held change.
kill_switch.reason_hint: Say what happened, for the audit log and whoever reactivates the agents.
kill_switch.confirm_body: Every agent stops acting at once, and the pending holds on the agent registry are withdrawn. It is not undone here: reactivating an agent is a held change.
